notes._policy: Version 1 allowlist: user and user_connection sync with the same save timing and persistence requirements. Includes portable parser, appearance, catalog, playback and Shots preferences plus the encrypted CUB login and selected profile. Oversized uploads fail without dropping values; any storage write failure disables sync for the page. All other scopes and unclassified keys stay local. Prefixes end in *; exact entries override prefixes, then the longest prefix wins. The encrypt list alone chooses which exported keys the API seals; the backend knows no setting names. Classification does not itself change any upstream writer.
notes._extraction: The guard conservatively inventories all settings data-name values and quoted *_ concatenations, including buttons, translation/metric identifiers and a commented country_ expression. These non-storage fragments are classified locally and documented below; they do not authorize export.
notes._variable_keys: Audited variable consumers: Timeline.filename returns file_view or file_view_<active CUB profile>; Tracker builds account_timeline_sync_<profile>; ContentRows builds content_rows_<installed row name>; WorkerArray builds storage_<field>_update_time. Generic Params/Input names resolve through registered settings; player_need selects player/player_iptv/player_torrent. Plugin {storage_<key>} interpolation, Console enumeration and remote configuration can access arbitrary keys: unclassified keys remain local.
notes._cub_storage_sync: Storage.init registers online_view, torrents_view, search_history, online_last_balanser, user_clarifys and torrents_filter_data. WorkerArray/Object write through Storage.set on CUB fetch/socket updates and send changes via socket plus storage/update when CUB sync/premium is enabled. Plan 4 does not coordinate CUB writers: overlapping keys use last-save-wins behavior; torrents_filter_data remains cache despite CUB sync.
notes._cub_backup: CUB Backup.publish serializes all localStorage except app.js to users/backup/export; inject restores arbitrary returned keys through localStorage.setItem then reloads. This manual whole-device backup can replace every user, connection and external key, independently of Storage.sync. The next Plan 4 boot GET reapplies non-dirty server values and preserves dirty local edits; this file governs Svtlv sync only and does not restrict CUB backup.
notes.favorite: Must-sync local Favorite document contains bookmarks, likes, history, viewed and thrown categories plus cards. With CUB Permit.sync, mutations route to bookmarks/add/remove/clear and rendering uses CUB Bookmarks; the synced local document is unused in that mode. CUB caches/trackers stay external.
notes.file_view: Synced durable local playback positions, duration and percent. Timeline uses this unsuffixed key when CUB sync is off; the synced local document is unused while CUB progress sync is active. CUB first-profile initialization may copy it into the active profile key.
notes.file_view_*: External durable progress partitioned by CUB profile id. Account.Timeline imports timeline/dump/changelog and sends timeline/update for the active profile. Never enumerate, export or import CUB-profile progress through Svtlv sync, or treat its suffix as a Keycloak id.
notes.language: Portable interface/content language: Lang selects the dictionary and several catalog consumers use it. Keyboard layout and keyboard_default_lang remain device-specific; importing language must not replace those explicit device choices.
notes.tmdb_lang: Portable catalog metadata, artwork-logo and search language sent to TMDB. Does not configure a player, keyboard or endpoint.
notes.mine_reactions: Local map of reactions selected for media ids. Reaction submissions use the generated device lampa_uid; importing this map must not replay votes or synchronize that uid.
notes.online_last_balanser: Synced per-title online-provider choices, not credentials. Registered with CUB Storage.sync as object_string; plugins can supply its consumer. Missing providers are tolerated; overlapping CUB writes are not coordinated.
notes.online_view: Synced watched online hashes; CUB Storage.sync array_string also writes it. Overlapping CUB writes are not coordinated.
notes.online_watched_last: Synced last-viewed episode/voice history, used by card episode/continue logic. Storage.cache only bounds its size; no dedicated CUB Storage.sync registration.
notes.person_subscribes_id: User subscription ids, also written from CUB person/list and person/subscribe/unsubscribe responses. Importing local ids must not create remote subscriptions or overwrite the currently selected CUB account.
notes.search_history: Synced portable search history; CUB Storage.sync array_string also writes it. Overlapping CUB writes are not coordinated.
notes.torrents_view: Synced watched torrent identifiers, despite Storage.cache calls. CUB Storage.sync array_string also writes it; overlapping CUB writes are not coordinated.
notes.user_clarifys: Synced search-title clarifications keyed by media id; CUB Storage.sync object_object also writes it. Overlapping CUB writes are not coordinated.
notes.plugins: Device-local executable plugin URLs/configuration. Installed scripts can require platform APIs; first sync release must never install code from another device. CUB also supplies a separate account_plugins list.
notes.plugins_blacklist: Device-local plugin suppression list; keep aligned with this device's executable scripts, never import from another platform.
notes.menu_sort: Device menu ordering uses localized labels and installed plugin/features; keep local rather than copying labels across languages.
notes.menu_hide: Device menu visibility uses localized labels and installed plugin/features; keep local rather than copying labels across languages.
notes.start_page: Device startup target may refer to unavailable plugin components or last activity; keep local.
notes.content_rows*: Portable visibility choices for named content rows, including continue watching, recent/upcoming episodes and recommendations. Only installed row providers consume these booleans; syncing a choice neither installs a provider nor copies its cached content. The literal content_rows base is included by the conservative inventory.
notes.account_timeline_sync*: CUB Tracker adds _<profile id> to account_timeline_sync; stores remote version/time, not playback progress. Never export as user data.
notes.account_bookmarks_*: CUB profile-specific IndexedDB bookmark snapshots, not the local favorite document. Keep service-owned. Exact account_bookmarks_sync is the CUB version/time tracker.
notes.account_bookmarks_sync: CUB IndexedDB version/time tracker. Excluded from user data; guarded manually because tracker_name is passed by variable.
notes.account_bookmarks: Legacy CUB bookmark key still cleared on account reset/cache clearing; service-owned, never imported as local favorites.
notes.account: Synced CUB login object contains the token, email and selected profile, including any profile PIN. Listed in encrypt so the API seals the entire raw value. The selected profile follows the Svtlv account across devices; this is separate from Keycloak authentication. Clearing Svtlv-owned data on logout/account replacement also clears this local CUB login; it does not revoke the token at CUB. See _cub_account_apply for restart and remote-request limitations.
notes.cloud_token: Third-party cloud credential registered by Params; never export or conflate with Keycloak.
notes.cloud_use: Third-party cloud integration toggle tied to that device's cloud credential.
notes.terminal_access: Terminal.getAccess grants a generated remote-terminal credential; remain local, never a user preference.
notes.discuss_voited: Local remembered discussion votes after remote CUB discussion voting. Service-associated feedback state; excluded from initial Svtlv export.
notes.cub_domain: Selected CUB service mirror endpoint, visible in CUB settings through svtlv/settings.js. Keep device-local because mirror reachability and automatic failover depend on each device network.
notes.cub_mirrors: Device-supplied CUB mirror list read directly from localStorage.
notes.cub_alive: Generated last reachable CUB base URL from mirror failover, not a portable endpoint preference.
notes.cub_screensaver: Selected CUB video wallpaper URL consumed by the device screensaver; remain device-specific despite remote source.
notes.cub_theme: Device-selected CUB appearance extension; remain local with other rendering options.
notes.torrserver_url: Portable primary TorrServer endpoint; both URLs sync while each device selects its active link locally.
notes.torrserver_auth: Shared authentication toggle for both portable TorrServer URLs; sync with the shared credentials.
notes.torrserver_login: Must-sync shared TorrServer username for both URLs. Listed in encrypt so the API seals it in place; encryption policy is owned only by this file.
notes.torrserver_password: Must-sync shared TorrServer password for both URLs. Listed in encrypt so the API seals it in place; encryption policy is owned only by this file.
notes.torrserver_savedb: Controls whether playback writes a saved torrent into this TorrServer and records ownership. Connection-local behavior, not an account connection field.
notes.torrserver_preload: Stream preload behavior for the current TorrServer/device path; remain connection-local.
notes.torrserver_gts: Use TorrServer-provided streaming path when supported; depends on the configured server/client.
notes.parse_lang: Portable torrent-title search language used by the parser, separate from TMDB metadata and interface language.
notes.source: Portable catalog service preference (TMDB/CUB). Feature flags and CUB child-profile rules still apply locally.
notes.protocol: Service request scheme and CUB login retry preference; device/network-specific, not the language/content preference.
notes.setting_member: Input.edit remembers user-entered connection values/URLs across settings, potentially credentials. Exclude from export; never treat as benign history.
notes.parental_control_pin: Device parental PIN; keep local with that device's parental controls, never user data.
notes.parental_control_time: Device PIN-unlock timeout/state, not portable preference.
notes.player_normalization_*: Runtime normalization power/smooth/type settings depend on player/device. Also catches translation fragments; exact device settings remain explicit.
notes.player_segments_*: Fallback for unaudited segment types and translation fragments; keep local. Exact player_segments_ad and player_segments_skip entries override this prefix and sync the portable skip policies.
notes.player_normalization_step_*: Player translation fragment, excluded from export.
notes.player_normalization_type_*: Player translation fragment, excluded from export.
notes.player_segments_value_*: Player translation fragment, excluded from export.
notes.player_size_*: Player translation fragment, excluded from export; player_size itself is a device rendering choice.
notes.developer_*: Developer switches dynamically use developer_<name>; stay device-local. Exact developer_enabled and developer_nopremium remain explicit.
notes.storage_*: CUB WorkerArray dynamically builds storage_<field>_update_time; generated sync cursor, never user data.
notes.lampa_uid: Generated reaction/device identity; never propagate to another device.
notes.lampa_*: IndexedDB database-name fragment, not a storage user document. Exact lampa_uid stays generated cache state.
notes.region: Detected network geo result plus timestamp used for proxy selection; regenerated on each device.
notes.remote_helper: Device remote-control help display timestamps, not user history.
notes.torrents_filter: Local compound parser-result filters include quality, HDR, Dolby Vision and 3D constraints as well as language/tracker choices. Do not sync the whole value across devices with different playback capabilities.
notes.torrents_sort: Portable torrent-result sorting preference (popularity, seeders, size, title, tracker, date or viewed). Does not constrain codec, HDR, resolution or available providers.
notes.torrents_filter_data: Per-card compound parser filters bounded by cache and also written by CUB Storage.sync. Keep local because the same document includes device-dependent HDR, Dolby Vision, 3D and resolution constraints; it cannot be split by this top-level policy.
notes.recomends_list: Generated recommendation candidates derived from history, regenerate instead of exporting.
notes.recomends_scan: Recommendation scan bookkeeping, not actual watched history.
notes.ser_clarifys: Legacy cache-clear key without current read/write consumers; guarded through its literal in the clear list.
notes.timetable: Generated episode schedule/cache derived from favorites and metadata; rebuild on this device.

notes.torrserver_url_two: Portable secondary TorrServer endpoint; follows the same must-sync and account replacement rules as URL 1.
notes.torrserver_use_link: Device-local active TorrServer link, default one; never export or import the selector.
notes._cub_account_apply: Policy-only CUB account synchronization copies the existing login token and selected profile; it does not register a separate device with CUB. Restart the receiving Lampa after a remote CUB login, logout or profile change before using account-dependent screens: Storage.set alone does not emit CUB profile_select, rebuild every CUB/plugin cache or cancel old-profile requests. Device-specific CUB token validity and revocation remain controlled by CUB.
notes._rollout: Refresh all clients when deploying an expanded allowlist. Older pages keep their old in-memory policy and can omit newly synced fields in whole-document PUTs. Newly included local values without baseline fingerprints are dirty under the existing sync rules; concurrent edits use the existing last-save-wins merge.
notes.account_use: Portable CUB synchronization toggle. Sync alongside the encrypted account object; it grants no access without a valid CUB token and does not override window.lampa_settings account feature flags.
notes.account_email: Legacy CUB sign-in field; the synced account object already contains the login email. Keep this redundant form state external.
notes.account_password: Legacy CUB password input; the existing CUB token in encrypted account is sufficient for restored login. Never synchronize this field.
notes.parser_use: Portable parser enablement preference; does not bypass app-wide torrent or parser feature restrictions.
notes.parser_torrent_type: Portable parser engine preference (Jackett, Prowlarr or TorrServer), used with the synced endpoint definitions.
notes.parser_use_link: Device-local Jackett/Prowlarr link selection (one, two or both). Both endpoint definitions sync, but each device chooses which network paths it can reach, independently of torrserver_use_link.
notes.jackett_interview: Portable choice to poll all Jackett trackers or only healthy trackers.
notes.parse_in_search: Portable preference to include parser results in global search.
notes.parse_timeout: Synced user-configured parser request timeout; devices on slower connections can require a shared larger value.
notes.torrserver_search_type: Portable TorrServer search provider choice (Rutor, Torznab or both); the active TorrServer URL remains device-selected.
notes.jackett_url: Portable primary Jackett endpoint; sync both links while parser_use_link remains device-local. Reachability still depends on each device network.
notes.jackett_key: Synced primary Jackett API key. Listed in encrypt so the API seals it in place.
notes.jackett_url_two: Portable secondary Jackett endpoint; sync both links while parser_use_link remains device-local. Reachability still depends on each device network.
notes.jackett_key_two: Synced secondary Jackett API key. Listed in encrypt so the API seals it in place.
notes.prowlarr_url: Portable primary Prowlarr endpoint; sync both links while parser_use_link remains device-local. Reachability still depends on each device network.
notes.prowlarr_key: Synced primary Prowlarr API key. Listed in encrypt so the API seals it in place.
notes.prowlarr_url_two: Portable secondary Prowlarr endpoint; sync both links while parser_use_link remains device-local. Reachability still depends on each device network.
notes.prowlarr_key_two: Synced secondary Prowlarr API key. Listed in encrypt so the API seals it in place.
notes.parser_website_url: Legacy parser URL template registered by Params without an active bundled consumer. May contain an embedded API key; keep local rather than exporting an unused credential.
notes.background: Portable preference to show catalog backgrounds; local light-version and platform behavior still apply.
notes.background_type: Portable catalog background style (complex, simple or poster). Hardware-specific rendering and performance switches remain local.
notes.card_interfice_poster: Portable card appearance preference: show poster.
notes.card_interfice_cover: Portable card appearance preference: show cover.
notes.card_interfice_reactions: Portable card appearance preference: show reactions.
notes.card_quality: Portable preference to display media-quality badges on cards; does not select playback or image resolution.
notes.card_episodes: Portable preference to display episode information on cards.
notes.tmdb_only_released: Portable TMDB catalog filter to include only released titles; language already syncs via tmdb_lang. Poster resolution, proxy routes and detected image mirrors remain local to device/network capabilities.
notes.lgbt_content_block: Portable content-filter preference, shown on every platform and in every region. The saved On/Off choice controls card masking and title blocking; detected region never forces it on.
notes.playlist_next: Portable preference to play the next episode automatically when supported by the active player.
notes.player_timecode: Portable resume behavior (start again, continue or ask), separate from device-specific player engines and local timecode data.
notes.player_rewind: Portable seek-step preference in seconds; does not select a player engine or rendering method.
notes.player_segments_ad: Portable advertisement-segment policy (automatic, manual or disabled), consumed only when the player provides segment metadata.
notes.player_segments_skip: Portable intro/other-segment policy (automatic, manual or disabled), consumed only when the player provides segment metadata.
notes.subtitles_lang: Portable preferred subtitle language; unsupported players may ignore it.
notes.subtitles_start: Portable preference to enable subtitles at playback start when supported.
notes.subtitles_stroke: Portable subtitle outline preference for the built-in renderer; subtitle size and timing shift stay local.
notes.subtitles_backdrop: Portable subtitle background preference for the built-in renderer; subtitle size and timing shift stay local.
notes.subtitles_size: Visible in Player settings through svtlv/settings.js, but stays device-local because subtitle readability depends on screen size and viewing distance.
notes.adult_content_view: Portable adult-content approval. Visible in Other settings through svtlv/settings.js; enabling requires the existing age-confirmation choice and disabling restores confirmation. Sync the approval with the Svtlv account; CUB child-profile restrictions remain separate.
notes.shots_in_card: Portable Shots toggle to show the Shots entry on title cards. Audited in the official remote /plugin/shots script on 2026-10-22; Shots settings are not bundled in app.min.js.
notes.shots_in_player: Portable Shots toggle to show the Shots control in supported players. Audited in the official remote /plugin/shots script on 2026-10-22; does not select a player or enable unsupported recording capabilities.
notes._shots_storage: Only the two audited Shots settings sync; no shots_* wildcard. shots_created, shots_favorite and shots_map are CUB/profile-owned lists refreshed by the plugin. Likes and viewed requests use device lampa_uid; copying local vote/history markers would not transfer remote identity. Recording cooldowns, feed cursors, presentation timestamps and moderation state remain local. The remote plugin can change independently; re-audit its storage keys before expanding this policy.
notes._device_preferences: Keep screen/input/performance choices local: interface size, lite mode, animations, glass effects, scrolling, image resolution/cache, sound output/level, navigation, keyboard, screensaver/video support, player engines, HLS/scaling, normalization, volume, speed, subtitle size/shift and default video resolution. Menus use localized labels and installed features; startup targets can depend on local activity/components. Keep parental locks/PIN/unlock state, device name/identity, generated caches and network proxy/mirror selection local.
notes._verification: The Go bundle drift guard inventories app.min.js only, so it lists the two audited remote Shots settings in auditedRemoteStorageKeys instead of reporting them as stale exact entries. Node/Go policy assertions and design-document examples describe this allowlist.
